subject: Intel’s Machine Learning group is hiring System Analysts

messages.author: 3116e30c7beafcee
messages.subject: Intel’s Machine Learning group is hiring System Analysts
parts:
Intel Advanced Analytics is hiring Excellent System Analysts! 
Advanced Analytics is a cutting edge group who leads Intel's global predictive analytics and big data solutions is hiring talented System Analysts.  Intel is much more than just a semi-conductor manufacturer and deals with complex problems with high volume of data that require implementation of machine learning\ data mining\ optimization algorithms. As a part of our young, diverse and highly dynamic group, you will be exposed to exciting areas of practice. 
  
Work includes engagement with customers to clarify the business needs, analysis of big data sets, definition of requirements and taking part in finding a predictive analytics solution to solve challenging high value business problems. 
  
Qualifications 
Required: 
- Master's degree in information technology, industrial engineering, computer science, software engineering or similar with focus on ML\ optimization or statistics 
- Practical experience with artificial intelligence\ machine learning\ data mining algorithms during studies or previous employment. Related thesis is an advantage 
- Excellent analytical skills and knowledge in statistics and data analysis 
- Strong communication skills and customer orientation 
- Passion for solving intricate business problems using data science 
  
The following will be considered as an advantage: 
- Experience in stakeholder management and working in a global environment 
- Knowledge of software design life cycle and software design methodologies 
  

Please send CV and grades transcripts (BSc and MSc) to AA_H...@intel.com and write in the subject "CV for SA position - Your full name".
